ThingDef.label: scroll of fire damage
ThingDef.description: A prepared enchantment bound to parchment. Reading it fixes the effect permanently onto the weapon in the reader's hand. Sets its mark with a lick of flame, burning whoever it strikes.

ThingDef.label: scroll of shock damage
ThingDef.description: A prepared enchantment bound to parchment. Reading it fixes the effect permanently onto the weapon in the reader's hand. Discharges a jolt of lightning into whoever it strikes.

ThingDef.label: scroll of frost
ThingDef.description: A prepared enchantment bound to parchment. Reading it fixes the effect permanently onto the weapon in the reader's hand. Chills the blood of whoever it strikes, slowing them badly.

ThingDef.label: scroll of poison
ThingDef.description: A prepared enchantment bound to parchment. Reading it fixes the effect permanently onto the weapon in the reader's hand. Leaves a slow-acting toxin in every wound.

ThingDef.label: scroll of paralysis
ThingDef.description: A prepared enchantment bound to parchment. Reading it fixes the effect permanently onto the weapon in the reader's hand. Sometimes locks the victim's limbs for a few moments.

ThingDef.label: scroll of absorb health
ThingDef.description: A prepared enchantment bound to parchment. Reading it fixes the effect permanently onto the weapon in the reader's hand. Closes the wielder's wounds with the life it takes.
